env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_order.lgo a/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_fail.lgo b/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_scope.lgo c/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_complete.lgo d/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_control.lgo e/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_positions.lgo f/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_arms.lgo g/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_order.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_order.out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd b
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_fail.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_fail.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd c
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_scope.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_scope.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd d
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_complete.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_complete.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd e
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_control.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_control.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd f
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_positions.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_positions.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

cd g
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/try_switch_arms.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out

module example.com/switchtryorder

go 1.27
